t: A free tablet coding app for ages 5 to 7 to make stories with blocks.
steps: Find ScratchJr in the App Store, Google Play, or the Amazon store.
Ask IT whether school device management must approve the app.
Install the app on a test tablet.
Make a short story with two characters yourself.
Browse the ScratchJr Connect resource database for lessons.
Plan a first lesson with a read-aloud.
